title: AmEx Platinum: 200,000 + 100,000 Rewards Points ($5,000 Spend in 3 Months 1st & 2nd Year), $450 Travel Credit, $1,450 Annual Fee
body:
Deal: AmEx Platinum: 200,000 + 100,000 Rewards Points ($5,000 Spend in 3 Months 1st & 2nd Year), $450 Travel Credit, $1,450 Annual Fee

[littlesoldier] It expensive, but well worth the fee if you could use the perks
5 cards giving unlimited access to plaza premium lounges itself can worth $527.85 x 5
$450 travel credits can be used across hotels, flights etc.
$400 dining credits ($200 domestic, $200 global) can be easily used up for frequent traveller
$350 worth Accor plus explorer can redeem 2 free hotel nights up to value of $400 (each redemption requires 1 paid night)
[A9z4444] my card comes with $850 travel creadits and i still cant justify the annul fee
[A9z4444] @askbargain: lol bad value and unaffordable aren’t the same thing bro
[Traveller in motion] Then you're doing something wrong… Better to cancel
[jayz] I'm pretty sure the Accor free nights requires 2 nights stay. Pay 2 nights, get the 3rd night free.
[Traveller in motion] No. It's a 2 night stay minimum where 1 night can be free
[jayz] @Traveller in motion: https://www.accorplus.com/hotel-benefits/stay-plus-benefit/
Enjoy two nights on us every membership year. You get one free night when you stay a minimum of two nights, twice per membership year. Book early to make the most of it!
[Traveller in motion] @jayz: Yeah exactly what I said
You could book 1 night only and it could be the free one, now at least 2 nights and 1 can be free.. I've done it
[tanman72] Pretty sure the lounge access only apply to Primary card holder only comes October.
[littlesoldier] As mention in the deal, after 1 Oct 2026 only primary card holder will get the Priority Pass
But every card holders (primary / additional) will still gain access to Centurion Lounge and Plaza Premium Lounge
as accessing these lounges only need to present the AMEX card itself, not Priority Pass
[Aerith-Waifu] 5 cards giving unlimited access to plaza premium lounges itself can worth $527.85 x 5(plazapremiumlounge.com)
what is this? can you please explain? 5 cards?????
[Charles89] To access Centurion lounge and Plaza Premium lounge, you only need to present your platinum card, and 1 primary card + 4 sub cards = 5 cards.
[Aerith-Waifu] @Charles89: how do you give out 4 sub cards? like one for the mrs and one for the parents etc?
[Charles89] @Aerith-Waifu: You just need to apply for it, first 4 are free. They just need to be over 16 years old, and from memory, provide their drivers license details, only takes a few minutes. Whatever they spend, will be charged to you, and good thing with Amex is, each sub card holder can register their own Amex account on the app, so they will see their own transactions and spending. Whilst the primary card holder can see all.
[shutuptakemymoney101] Just put the annual fee on another credit card ;-)
[donkcat] When i click the link its up to 325k reward points
[rake] yea - some member referrals are 275K, some 300K and some 325K. The idea is to click the random referral link above multiple times until you get to one with 325K bonus.
[Wiadro] No one is playing this on the long game.
[punkel] I’m getting 325k
Note you have to commit to second year so $2900 total over 2 years for 325k
[lzaonne] It says the 100,000 points only for second year, where it says first year as well?
[Poor Ass] If you already have a amex no fee card will you qualify for the bonus points if applying?
[gadgetguy] Blackout period, still 18 months for any Amex card?
[evgpek] This offer is only available to new American Express Card Members. Card Members who currently hold or who have previously held any Card product issued by American Express Australia Limited in the past 18 months are ineligible for this offer.
[NRGIZE] God it's annoying…. Don't they want our business upgrading our cards lol
[NRGIZE] Let me guess can't apply due to having one within 12/18 months….. 🔥
[Soapdroid] If you travel a lot and can use the benefits, this card is amazing. And they're the only customer service I've found that will actually fix a problem. You might have to ask a few times… Don't use the card to spend overseas though. Save that for a mastercard without fees. I love this card
[dtc] Warning that a free subscription to The Australian will result in a need for psychiatric care
[Cheepcheep88] Just the points, no. The points and the benefits for the first 2 years if you can utilise them well, yes.
[smbird] Heads up for anyone hitting minimum spend targets - all card payment surcharges (including Amex) are officially getting scrapped across Australian merchants starting 1 October 2026!
[starburstyellow] Sorry I'm not getting it. If I apply for this card (having not had an Amex for over 2 years), will that impact the bonus I'm having?
I don't understand the comment about "hitting minimum spend targets". Thanks in advance!
[Menzoberranzan] You need to hit $5k spend in 90 days to get the first year sign up bonus. That's it.
[starburstyellow] Ok thank you! Thats what I thought, got confused with the comment "anyone hitting minimum spend targets" and the relationship with the scrapped merchant fees.
[MrWwhiteAU] Check the fine print. all credit card charges are changing after 30th september aligining with credti card surcharge removal
[DandenongBad] If I applied for an Amex Velocity card last year and am still holding it, will I be eligible to claim the offer?
[su27km] you need plan on 5000 spending, lots of place are not accept AMEX… i am currently on this headache
[djkelly69] Coles, Woolies, big department stores, etc, all take it without surcharge. Not that difficult for my family at least!
[Charles89] Having had an Amex for the last 5 years, I have found that a lot of places DO take Amex, especially all of the big retailers and has been increasing. Although I can't say what will happen after 1st of October.
[captainfalcon23] This seems better, no? https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/969541
[gstfree] I have an additional card but I dont have primary account with Amex in the past 20 months. Do I eligible for this offer? Thanks.
[littlesoldier] yes, only holding additional card doesnt count towards the 18months requirements
so you will be fine getting the welcome bonus (after meeting the spending requirement)
[iykyk] Has anyone got offer if they've had this card within past 12 months?
